videocompress.drop: Drop a video here, or click to choose one
videocompress.label.result: The smaller video — check it before downloading
videocompress.status.idle: The video is opened only in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
videocompress.err.open: Your browser could not open this video. mp4 and webm usually work.
videocompress.err.unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Try Chrome or Edge.
videocompress.err.hidden: You switched tabs while it was working — the picture may have frozen during that time. Check the result, and if it looks wrong, run it again with this tab visible.
videocompress.say.progress: Re-encoding… {left} left — keep this tab visible
videocompress.say.noGain: It did not get smaller ({from} → {to}). This video is already well compressed. Lowering the frame size or quality will shrink it, but it will look softer.
